title: Default Parameter Values
instructions:
Complete the `GamePiece` class so it has:
- `type` of type `String` with a default value of `"cone"`
- `points` of type `Int` with a default value of `3`

Both should be read-only. Then in `main()`, create two GamePiece objects:
1. One using the defaults (no arguments)
2. One with type `"cube"` and points `5`

Print each one in the format: `{type}: {points} points`
hint: Write default values with `=` in the constructor: `val type: String = "cone"`. Create the default one with `GamePiece()` and the custom one with `GamePiece("cube", 5)`.
